scope: Source, data and method review only; no predictions, development search results, strategy selections, index rankings, or graph.json read. Graph construction assessed from generator source only.

findings.detail: Mechanism template holdout shares the same rule and question grammar across dev/test, and three parameterized instances per template. It tests lexical mechanism holdout within this stipulated generator, not unseen causal topology or natural-language question generation.

The graph compiles three main-chain edges and one independent monitoring edge per scenario. Parameter, applicability, hold-time and inverse-boundary records remain text-only. Equal fact provenance means graph facts have textual counterparts; it must not be described as all 576 records fully represented in graph structure. This asymmetry may disadvantage graph-only strata and should be disclosed.

150 requested candidates is divided 150/75/50 by route count, with common 50 fused pool, 10 final records, 5 per document and 4096-token caps. This is an equal candidate/output budget, not a measured equal compute/latency budget; route shortfalls and duplicates may reduce actual unique candidates.

Only eight held-out template clusters support the primary bootstrap. Treat uncertainty as conditional on this small controlled population; do not interpret 144 test questions as independent real maintenance cases.

Retrieval metrics score necessary evidence records, not generated answer correctness. Boundary records directly state the intended non-invertibility, which is valid under the declared record-level rule world.

decision_rationale: Approved as an explicitly synthetic, record-level retrieval benchmark. All 216 question support assignments and chain bridges pass complete mechanical checks; the generator establishes unique main-chain paths and explicit inverse boundaries. No empirical ranking or desired winner was consulted. Approval does not establish physical validity, real-world diagnostic accuracy, or production readiness. Revised public documentation adequately addresses L1-L3 wording. Approval remains limited to source/data/method scope; initial limitations L1-L5 all still apply.

revision_review.verification: Revised protocol/README explicitly disclose graph fact subset, shared question/rule grammar, and candidate budget not equal actual computation. Corpus and dev/test hashes in revised freeze equal independently reviewed initial hashes. Graph content was never opened; its unchanged status is author-reported and the freeze records its hash. Revised generator script was not reread under this limited revision scope; initial source review and its hash remain archived.
revision_review.ranking_state: No predictions, candidate files, development outputs, strategy selections or rankings accessed; before_any_rankings is a declared provenance flag, not independently verified from forbidden runtime outputs.
